sections.title: Rank the local catalog
sections.spoken_text: This local scorer explains why clear refund metadata is easy to find in a catalog of sixty-four tools. It tokenizes the query, gives three points for a name match, two for a search hint and one for a description. The vague billing operation has no refund hint, so a broad refund query cannot find it. An exact select query still resolves it. These scores are teaching estimates, not native ToolSearch ranking or billed token counts.

sections.title: Record one exact refund
sections.spoken_text: The refund handler accepts only the synthetic invoice INV-2042, exactly forty-nine hundred euro cents, currency EUR and reason duplicate-charge. It reloads an owned ledger under a run UUID. With a lock, the first valid call writes receipt RF-2042-1 and its tool call ID; a duplicate returns already-recorded. The host independently reloads and hashes the ledger before awarding a check.

sections.title: Verify native discovery
sections.spoken_text: The native run registers sixty-four in-process MCP tools and enables ToolSearch. The pre-use hook and permission callback admit only search and the exact refund input. The host requires a structured tool reference result before the refund handler, a matching tool result and ledger receipt, one successful SDK terminal and bounded cost. A model statement alone does not prove discovery or mutation.
